notes: Governing document: Faculty Handbook ch. III (Officers of Instruction), Leaves of Absence last revised November 2008, Wayback capture 2018-02-26; Benefits chapter capture 2018-02-27. Tenure-stream faculty on the Morningside campus (Arts and Sciences, Engineering and the other Morningside Faculties) are the main campus; the Medical Center (Dental Medicine, Medicine, Nursing, Public Health) is not (V3b).

2018_03 New Parents' Guide is a summary dated 4/25/2018 (after the reference date, same academic year); used only to supply details of provisions the handbook contains (the 6-8 week childbirth period, V1b; 'partial salary' for partial child care leave) and to record provisions for other groups whose governing documents are cited but not saved (governing document cited but not saved: c22-c26 flagged cross_reference_not_saved, not summary_only).

2018_04 Columbia NY Paid Family Leave policy (effective 2018-01-01) states 'PFL does not apply to Officers of Instruction'; coded for the covered groups (c20 benefit, c21 job-protected leave), flagged excludes_main_faculty.

The general Medical Leaves paragraph (leave with full salary up to six months for any illness or injury) is the same leave as c1 applied to childbirth; the specific childbirth paragraph governs, so the leave is coded once (c1) with the general plan's pay recorded as c3. Partial medical leave with partial salary for partial disability is not coded separately (not a childbirth provision).

Birth-parent chain: childbirth medical leave c1 (up to 6 months; full salary c2, typically 6-8 weeks, and c3 within it) -> child care leave without salary c7 (or partial c8), total normally one year (leave_limits 52); FMLA c17 alongside from the start of c1; disability beyond six months -> LTD c4 with unpaid medical leave c6. Alternative (in_lieu_of): workload relief c9 one term at full salary, or c10 a year at full salary with half load, or c11 a year at half salary.

Non-birth-parent chain: child care leave without salary c7 (up to one year, begun within the first year; or partial c8), FMLA c17 alongside from its start; alternative (in_lieu_of): workload relief c9 / c10 / c11 if the primary parent.

Workload relief versus the leaves: the plan 'is designed to replace the combination of medical and/or child care leaves', and eligible faculty 'may still elect to take those leaves rather than ask for workload relief', so c1, c2 and c7 are linked in_lieu_of c9-c11 (R15b); but the FMLA sentence ('If workload relief is not preceded by other periods of leave covered by the FMLA') suggests relief may follow a leave. Flagged ambiguous on c1; a reader taking the relief as additional to the childbirth medical leave would link c9 consecutive_after c1 (R3d).

Adoption assistance (reimbursement up to $5,000), dependent-care FSA, child-care benefit, backup care, lactation rooms, child-care centres and the School for Children are services or reimbursements, not leave, pay, relief or protection: not components.
